source_grounding.note: Critical finding: strictGroupSize is extracted from HTTP request (line 501 request_v2.go) and passed through rankParams/groupByInfo getters, BUT: (1) ResultInfo struct (reduce/reduce_info.go) does NOT have a strictGroupSize field, (2) GroupByOp.Execute() never checks the flag, (3) No validation logic enforces strict group size. Parameter is a no-op.

verdicts.rationale: The strictGroupSize parameter is a documented API feature that is completely non-functional. Source code tracing proves: (1) Parameter is parsed from HTTP request (request_v2.go:501), (2) Extracted via GetStrictGroupSize() methods (search_util.go:96-101), (3) BUT never passed to reduce layer (ResultInfo missing field), (4) Never checked in GroupByOp.Execute(). Groups with size > groupSize are returned regardless of strictGroupSize value. This is a clear Type1_IllegalSuccess - API accepts configuration parameter but silently ignores it, violating user expectations.
